question: How many casual leaves do I get?
answer: 12 days per financial year, prorated for joiners.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How many sick leaves do I get?
answer: 12 days per financial year. A medical certificate is needed beyond 2 days.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How does earned leave work?
answer: It accrues at 1.25 days per month and up to 30 days can be carried forward.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: Is leave without pay allowed?
answer: Yes, when other balances are exhausted. It is deducted on a calendar-day basis.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: What is the maternity leave policy?
answer: 26 weeks of paid maternity leave as per statute.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: What are the office hours?
answer: 9:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday. Core hours are 11:00 to 16:00.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: Do we have to work on Saturdays?
answer: No. Saturday and Sunday are weekly offs.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How does overtime pay work?
answer: Eligible roles (L1-L2 in Support, HR, Finance, Operations) get 2x hourly pay, capped at 50 hours a month.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: When is salary paid?
answer: On the first working day of the following month.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How is LOP calculated?
answer: Monthly fixed pay divided by calendar days, multiplied by days without pay.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: When is the performance bonus paid?
answer: With the April payroll, based on the latest appraisal rating, for employees with 12 months of service.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How often are salaries revised?
answer: Annually from 1 April, based on the appraisal rating. Promotions can happen at the same time.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How is PF calculated?
answer: 12% of basic, with a wage ceiling of 15,000 basic per month, from employee and employer.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: Who is covered by ESI?
answer: Employees whose monthly fixed gross is 21,000 or less.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: What is professional tax?
answer: A state tax of 200 per month for employees earning 25,000 or more a month (sample rule).
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How is TDS decided?
answer: On projected annual income using the slabs shown in the Tax screen, spread across 12 months.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: When do I get Form 16?
answer: After the financial year closes, usually by mid June.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How long is the notice period?
answer: 30 days for L1-L2, 60 days for L3, 90 days for L4 and above.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: Can I buy out my notice period?
answer: Yes, with manager and HR approval, by paying the shortfall in notice pay.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: What is the probation period?
answer: Six months, reviewed by manager and HR.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: What is the work from home policy?
answer: Hybrid, about three office days a week for most roles. Some roles are fully remote.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How do I claim travel expenses?
answer: Submit bills within 30 days in the Expenses screen.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: Who approves my expenses?
answer: Your head of department approves; Finance pays in the next cycle.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: What insurance do I have?
answer: Group health cover for you, spouse and up to two children.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How do I add a dependent to insurance?
answer: Within 30 days of joining or a life event, through the Benefits screen.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: What training is available?
answer: Each employee gets a learning budget and access to the online library; target is 24 hours a year.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How do I update my bank details?
answer: Raise a request in the Profile screen; HR verifies within 3 working days.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: Who do I contact for payroll queries?
answer: payroll@znova-demo.example
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: What is the dress code?
answer: Business casual; smart casual on Fridays.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)

question: How are holidays decided?
answer: A calendar is published every January with national and regional holidays.
policy_source: Zenith Nova HR Policy Handbook v3.2 (fictional, for training)
